reconstruction.pairedInputs: Same original photographs, product groups, independent references, Gemini model/version/config/schema/task/validation/scoring and non-perception access. Only allowed observations differ.
reconstruction.ocrPreservation: Native real text, order, reading regions/geometry if supplied; no model cleanup or human-corrected prefill. Local engines see photos, text-only Gemini requests do not.

unfamiliarProductGroupsRequested.unitOfIndependence: productGroupId; variants, crops, repeated captures and related family members stay in one split
unfamiliarProductGroupsRequested.splits: development/calibration/held-out assigned and human reviewed before freeze; any known exposed family permanently development

reconstruction.budgetPolicy: Prefer all five on identical held-out groups. If budget constrained, A/B/C on identical groups and D/E on a predeclared identical paired subset; report separate denominators and do not claim full five-arm results.
reconstruction.adapterIntegrationStatus: pending-owner-integration: existing experiment-plan.json and runner modality mapping describe earlier arms; this manifest is not a directly executable replacement
measures: ingredient names omissions inventions order percentages
generations tool rounds retries recoveries tokens estimated versus billed cost
reconstruction.fallbackPolicy: Changed model/config/modality is noncomparable; retain failures/retries and unavailable metrics without silently pooling.

conversation.providerGenerations: measure actual count including tool rounds; may exceed 27
conversation.packageFacts: one fixed human-reviewed package snapshot per exact product/revision, no repeated extraction

knowledgeAblation.design: nine paired initial turns; no full factorial by OCR method/database
controls: identical frozen initial context and package/profile/question
same model/config/base prompt and output contract
only external knowledge availability differs; freeze both tool manifests
freeze source snapshots and record relevance/applicability/use
reuse exact matching knowledge-enabled conversation receipt; otherwise record reason for fresh generation
blind random arm labels/order; retain actual mapping privately

humanReview.scale: 0 incorrect/unusable; 1 major problems; 2 mixed; 3 mostly correct/useful; 4 fully supported/useful; null not applicable or not yet rated with reason
humanReview.adjudication: Preserve independent ratings and disagreements, then human adjudicator records reasoned decision; critical errors reported separately from means.

existingAnswerScorerMapping.grounding: factualCorrectness and packageEvidenceCorrectness; human mapping decision required
existingAnswerScorerMapping.actionability: practicalUsefulness; retain full nine-dimension sheet separately
